descriptor.name: Maryland Parcel Boundaries (MD iMAP) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: Maryland Department of Planning and State Department of Assessments and Taxation, via MD iMAP
descriptor.scope: Maryland statewide parcel polygons (all 24 jurisdictions) published by MDP. POLYID is the MDP polygon identifier, prefixed by the two-digit jurisdiction number; it was populated and unique for every polygon sampled.
caveats: POLYID identifies the MDP parcel polygon, not the SDAT assessment account; the account field is deliberately not used (it is blank or ROW on some polygons and repeated across distinct polygons in Gaithersburg).
POLYID stability across MDP releases is not documented; the polygon date is in the source polydate field (not requested).
The publisher dissolves polygons with matching account IDs; right-of-way polygons (account value ROW) carry their own POLYID and are included.
Layer also publishes owner, address and assessment fields, which are not requested.
descriptor.attribution: MD iMAP, Maryland Department of Planning, SDAT. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: MD iMAP layer description: "parcel polygons of the entire state" attributed with SDAT and MDP data; all 24 Maryland jurisdiction codes present on 2026-10-12.
